publishedProjects.name: Sacred Interval · Church of Dissociation
publishedProjects.description: A publicly accessible reading and exploration site with philosophical texts, interpretation, consent and community-oriented materials. The website is live; this does not establish legal institutional status, treatment credentials or verified real-world gatherings.
publishedProjects.dateLabel: Public website checked; wider community status unverified

project-rhymemosaic.description: The public poetry reading room now includes visible split-copy controls: Copy + link for credited sharing and TXT for poem text only, without opening More. The v44 release record reports clipboard-content checks; a fresh public click check confirmed TXT success feedback. Mobile visual acceptance remains separate.
project-rhymemosaic.dateLabel: Hosted v44 release reviewed; live split-copy controls clicked

project-hydra-index.description: An evidence-conscious compound and research reference. Its current public health endpoint reports release 67529258 ready. Source-linked study reading, the Observatory and research discovery remain its central public routes.

project-threads-observatory.description: An owner-only creative studio for post-performance history, source-linked word and poetry intake, and editorial queue review. The current site record reports v15. Private content and publishing approval remain separate.

project-resonance-atlas-synchronicity.description: An owner-only workspace for recording coincidences, examining patterns and comparing interpretations. Its current site record reports v9. Recorded experiences are not treated as proof of causality.

project-public-deception-atlas.description: An owner-only source-linked research project about public claims, documented misrepresentation and counterevidence. The current site record reports v15; its private case material is not exposed through this directory.

project-forge-lexicon.description: The language-development pipeline keeps experiments, exact usage witnesses and reviewed definitions distinct. The private reconciliation retains 203 public term records and 313 definition versions while collecting 42 candidate forms and 10 source witnesses. These overlapping counts are not additive unique-word totals; new candidates are not automatically published.
project-forge-lexicon.dateLabel: Private reconciliation and creative inbox checked; no new public terms

project-brandonmeant.description: One half of the poetry diptych. A full-reader proof is undergoing text-extraction, layout and accessibility review; author approval, retailer checks and a verified commercial release remain separate.

project-the-wreckage-arranged-me.description: The companion poetry collection remains in private proof review. Revised reader and print files are distinguished from historical text witnesses and from a verified retail publication.

project-sanford-resource-hub.description: A public, mobile-oriented guide to local support in Sanford and Lee County: meals, essential services, contacts, maps and practical planning. Provider availability should still be confirmed before travel.

project-techenlight.description: Public technology services covering device troubleshooting, websites, practical AI and one-to-one tutoring. Its project section now also links directly to the public Sanford Resource Hub; that connection was independently checked.
project-techenlight.dateLabel: Public service website and Sanford cross-link checked

now.title: Poetry, easier to carry
now.text: The poem toolbar has Copy + link and one-click TXT. Keep the words alone, or take their title, author and source link with them.

now.title: Another public doorway
now.text: Sacred Interval now has a verified public reading site. Its wider community and institutional claims remain distinct from website availability.

now.title: Words in development
now.text: The newest lexical candidates are consolidated privately; existing public words and definition history remain intact. Proposed meanings are not final entries.

now.title: Beyond finished products
now.text: Four retained concepts remain visible alongside public sites, prototypes and historical work. An idea belongs on the map without pretending it has launched.

boundaries: Public-facing metadata only. No private app URLs, raw conversations, manuscripts, credentials or medical/legal records.
A review date is not a creation date. Host release records are not claims of full device acceptance.
Public website availability does not establish institutional status, professional credentials, community activity or the truth of every claim on that website.
Ideas remain concepts until implementation and deployment are independently established.
No new dictionary entry, poem or private source document is published by this reconciliation.
